errors.evidence: The labeled y-axis ticks are at 82, 84, 86, 88, 90, which indicates a tick interval of 2%, not 1%.
At mBERT-0, the values are misrepresented: Precision is below 82% (~81.2%), Recall is below 84% (~83.5%), and F1 Score is significantly lower than stated, being near 82% (~82.3%) rather than 84%.

At mBERT-100, Precision is approximately 89% (well above the 88 line), Recall is above 90% (~90.5%), and F1 Score is nearly 90% (~89.7%). The reported values are consistently lower than the actual data points.
